subject: Post-demo: cost math, unit-econ scenarios & proposed model split
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orionhealth.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-19T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: cost math, unit-econ scenarios & proposed model split

Hi Lina / Evan — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned on costing and model mix before we build the pilot SOW.

Call summary (very high level):
- Primary use: patient triage + internal clinical search (chat + embeddings + rerank).
- Expected steady-state traffic: roughly 100–200M tokens / month in Year 1.
- Key constraints: strict latency threshold for chat (p95 < 300ms), SOC2 evidence required, and procurement prefers a clear $/1M-token target.

Ask from us: can you confirm a 30/60/10 split vs the example below? If not, share a preferred split and a hard monthly budget range. We’ll use your inputs to finalize a pilot price and the proposed model routing.

Example pricing targets we discussed on the call (ballpark, for scoping):
- Target unit goal you mentioned: $1,200–$1,600 per 1M tokens (monthly blended target)
- Proposed model mix for scoping (we recommended): chat 65%, embeddings 25%, rerank 10%
- For 150M tokens / month this implies a blended ARR run-rate in the ~$180k/year range before discounts (Jonas will send scenarios).

I attached a short spreadsheet with three scenarios (conservative / mid / aggressive) that map token volumes to per-model routing and monthly cost. Please confirm the monthly volume range that’s realistic for Q4 so we can lock the pilot numbers.

Next steps
- Lina: confirm monthly token band (low / expected / high) and target $/1M tokens range — reply here.
- Orion procurement: share any PO/contract cadence requirements or vendor questionnaire deadlines.
- Redwood: we’ll send an initial SOW + pricing scenarios by EOD tomorrow and propose a pilot discount for a 3-month evaluation.

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Scenarios_20250719.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — Jonas

Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orionhealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Chu <evan.chu@orionhealth.ai>, procurement@orionhealth.ai
Date: 2025-07-20T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost math, unit-econ scenarios & proposed model split

Jonas — thanks for the recap and the fast follow. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Volume bands (monthly tokens) — our current estimate for product team usage:
   - Low: 80M tokens/month (initial pilot limited usage)
   - Expected: 150M tokens/month (our go-forward projection for first 6 months)
   - High: 300M tokens/month (if we expand to additional workflows)

2) Budget guidance — leadership set a target blended unit cost: $1,000–$1,400 per 1M tokens (this is what we’d like to see in an enterprise proposal).

3) Model mix (what the product team expects):
   - Chat (real-time triage): ~60%
   - Embeddings (search + similarity): ~30%
   - Rerank (post-embedding candidates): ~10%

4) Compliance / procurement asks: we need SOC2 Type II evidence and a short vendor questionnaire (I’ll attach the questionnaire — procurement@). Can you confirm retention windows and whether logs can be pushed to our S3?

If you can show 3 scenarios mapped to our bands with a blended $/1M token row and an explicit per-model cost assumption, that’ll help the execs sign off. We’re available for a quick follow-up on Thursday.

—Lina
Lina Gomez
Head of Product, Clinical AI | Orion Health
Lina.gomez@orionhealth.ai | +1 617-555-2090

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orionhealth.ai>, Evan Chu <evan.chu@orionhealth.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-20T13:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: cost math, unit-econ scenarios & proposed model split

Lina — perfect, thanks for the clear bands and unit target. Attached is the spreadsheet that maps three scenarios to per-model routing and blended $/1M tokens. Highlights below (mid scenario = your 150M expected):

Assumptions we used (mid):
- Chat model: low-latency chat-large-v1 at $2.40 per 1k tokens equivalent (this is our internal pricing kernel for scoping).
- Embeddings: embed-compact-v1 at $0.30 per 1k tokens equivalent.
- Rerank/light-transformer: rerank-small-v1 at $0.55 per 1k tokens equivalent.
- Note: our runtime optimizations (dynamic batching + KV prefix caching) assume 15% effective token reduction on chat in steady state for repeated prefixes. We included that in the blended math.

Scenario math (rounded):
- Low (80M): blended $/1M = $1,520 -> monthly = $121.6k
- Mid (150M): blended $/1M = $1,260 -> monthly = $189k
- High (300M): blended $/1M = $1,050 -> monthly = $315k

Proposed model split for the SOW (based on your preference): chat 60% / embeddings 30% / rerank 10%. In the spreadsheet I included a per-model cost breakout and an optional quantization profile for chat (which can reduce the chat per-1k by ~20% at slightly higher latency tradeoff).

Compliance answers: yes, we can provide SOC2 Type II report and push audit logs to an S3 destination with a contractual retention window. I’ll attach the SOC2 cover letter and we can share the full report under NDA.

Next steps:
- I’ll propose a 3-month pilot price (20% pilot discount off the mid scenario for the expected band) and draft a short SOW.
- Vanessa / Neha: can you confirm if we’re okay to propose the 20% pilot concession and whether legal needs a different SOW template?

Attachments: Redwood_Pricing_Scenarios_20250719.xlsx, SOC2_Cover_Letter.pdf

Thanks — Jonas

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-21T10:06:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Orion pilot discount approval (need greenlight)

Vanessa / Neha — copying you on the thread with Orion. Key points for approval:
- They indicated expected = 150M tokens/mo and want blended $1,000–$1,400 per 1M tokens.
- I modeled mid scenario at $1,260/1M. I’m proposing a pilot concession: 20% off mid scenario for first 3 months to remove friction and let product team validate. That lands the pilot blended at ~$1,008/1M (for 150M band).
- Attachments include the pricing spreadsheet and a draft SOW (SOW-draft-Orion-Health-20250719.docx).

Questions:
1) Acceptable to give 20% pilot discount for a 3-month pilot (no-level-of-effort guarantee)?
2) Any procurement/finance guardrails we must include (e.g., 45-day Net30, PO requirements)?

If we have a greenlight I’ll send a formal SOW + procurement checklist to Lina and loop in Marissa (legal) for a standard enterprise SOW.

Thanks — Jonas

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-22T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Orion pilot discount approval (need greenlight)

Jonas — ok to proceed with a 20% pilot discount for three months. A couple of guardrails:
- Finance: pilot invoiced monthly, Net30, PO preferred but we can accept an initial email approval for the pilot.
- Legal: include clause that usage above the expected band will be billed at the standard mid scenario rates (no retroactive credits).
- SOW: keep the pilot scope limited to the two initial workflows (triage + search). Add a telemetry handoff milestone at 45 days.

Marissa — can you take a look at the attached SOW and redline for the standard pilot language? Once redlined, Jonas please attach to the external reply and copy procurement at Orion.

Vanessa
Senior Director, GTM | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
